method: v2: (1) weights cut from the Regular/Bold masters to hit measured stem/cap; (2) proportion edits from the pangram at 3 display sizes (letter widths scaled about the ink centre with advances unchanged; ascenders +4% cap, descenders -4.6% cap, i/j dots +2% cap); (3) tracking(w)=a0+a1*(wght-420)/190 em fitted by least squares on glyph left edges rendered in Chromium at cap-matched size over 41 UI strings (20 distinct texts), model chosen by leave-one-text-out validation (held-out 0.97 css px vs 1.08 without the edits)
